turns.question: What share of leads created in September 2026 went on to a booking?
turns.answer: The lead-to-booking rate for leads created 1 to 30 September 2026 is 38.57 % (share of leads that booked within 30 days of being created). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
